description: Use this when the user wants invitations to one of their funds sent again to the investors already invited. Starts resending them to the addresses each invitation is out to. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed invitations to resend for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_resend_fund_invitations
title: Resend fund invitations
